title: ऐतिहासिक भौतिकवादको कसीमा प्रेतकल्प Aaitihasik Bhautikvadko Kasima Pretkalpa
nepali: यस लेखमा ऐतिहासिक भौतिकवाद के हो; यसले साहित्यलाई कसरी हेर्छ र साहित्यभित्रको अन्तर्वस्तु र रूपको अन्तर्सम्बन्धबारे केकस्तो मान्यता राख्छ भन्ने सैद्धान्तिक पक्षलाई सङ्क्षिप्त रूपमा चिनाइएको छ । प्रकृति, समाज र चिन्तनको समग्र द्वन्द्वात्मक विकासको वैज्ञानिक खोज ऐतिहासिक भौतिकवाद हो भने साहित्यले वर्ग, द्वन्द्व, चेतना रक्रान्तिको मार्गदर्शन गर्दै समाज रूपान्तरणलाई मूल धेय बनाउँछ । त्यसै गरी वस्तु तथा सङ्घटनालाई निर्माण गर्ने तत्त्व तथा प्रक्रियालाई अन्तर्वस्तु र त्यसको प्रस्तुति, तरिका, शैली तथा संरचना रूप हो । यसका आधारमा साहित्यका विभिन्न विधामा रचित सृजनाहरूको विश्लेषण गर्न सकिन्छ । नारायण ढकालले प्रेतकल्पउपन्यास ऐतिहासिक भौतिकवादी चिन्तनलाई आधार बनाई रचना गरेका छन् । यस रचनामापूर्वी काठमाडौँको दुःखपुरमा काशीबाट शास्त्री पढेर फर्किएको आर्यसमाजी विचारबाट प्रभावित बालकृष्ण पात्रले फैलाएको विचार, तर्क र व्यवहारबाट स्थापित पुरातन मान्यता भत्कदै क्रमशः नवीन मूल्यको स्थापना हुन थालेको तथ्यलाई द्वन्द्वात्मक रूपमा चिनाइएको छ ।समाज परिवर्तनको गति चिनाउन यो उपन्यास सफल देखिएको छ । यस लेखमाउक्त रचनामा अन्तर्निहित तत्कालीन शासक वर्गविरुद्ध शोषित निम्न वर्गमा पलाएको शूक्ष्म जागरणका झिल्का र अन्तर्विरोधका स्वरहरूलाई ऐतिहासिक भौतिकवादी कोणबाट चिनाउन खोजिएको छ ।
american_english: In this article, the theoretical aspects of what historical materialism is, how it views literature, and what assumptions it maintains regarding the interrelationship between content and form within literature are briefly outlined. While historical materialism is the scientific investigation into the overall dialectical development of nature, society, and thought, literature guides class, conflict, consciousness, and revolution, making societal transformation its principal aim. Likewise, the elements and processes that construct objects and phenomena constitute content, whereas their presentation, method, style, and structure constitute form. On this basis, works composed across diverse genres of literature can be analyzed. Narayan Dhakal composed the novel Pretkalpa based on historical materialist thought. In this work, the fact that established traditional norms crumble and modern values gradually begin to be established through the ideas, logic, and conduct spread by the character Balkrishna—who returned to Dukhapur in eastern Kathmandu after studying for his Shastri degree in Kashi and was influenced by Arya Samaj ideals—is dialectically portrayed. This novel proves successful in demonstrating the momentum of social change. In this article, an attempt is made to identify, from a historical materialist angle, the subtle sparks of awakening and voices of contradiction that sprouted within the exploited lower class against the ruling class of that era inherent in the said work.

This novel appears successful in capturing the pace of social change. In this article, an attempt is made to delineate, from a historical materialist perspective, the subtle sparks of awakening and voices of contradiction that arose within the exploited lower class against the ruling class of that era inherent within the work.
